status.holdout: v2 failed its holdout (July 2024 - June 2026, run once): 0.81 of actual defaults under the recorded check, 0.92 counted correctly (L-038, L-039).
status.overlay: No overlay (Option B): the LGD model's conservatism (1.64x the real loss per default, L-033) more than offsets the default shortfall (0.74 in loss terms). The +34% default uplift is shown as a sensitivity.
status.framing: Educational model on Freddie Mac conforming mortgages (sample book). Not an audited bank reserve and not accounting advice.

steps.what: Origination and monthly performance files, read from the zips; data contracts per file version
Delta tables on Databricks, DuckDB and Parquet on the PC; one row per loan per month in the panel
FRED, FHFA house prices, BLS state unemployment, the Fed's scenarios; Airflow downloads, contracts and freshness checks
PD and payoff transition models (MLflow), LGD and EAD; selection rules committed before each test
Each loan's lifetime expected loss under three scenarios, weighted; overlays only under ADR-006
Rollforward to the cent, reserve bridge, disclosure tables, allowance memo with maker and checker sign-off
Aggregates only, after every check passes; no loan rows ever

controls: Tie-outs on every run: loan counts and balances match the source; the book reserve equals the sum of loan reserves
Data contracts per Freddie file version, per economic source and for the call reports; a failure stops the load
Quarter-end snapshots: data (Delta time travel), model (MLflow) and code (git tag)
Every test's rules committed before it runs; run-once tests never re-run without written approval
Change log and limitations log with an owner and a fix date for every item
No run on a Monday before 13:00 or between 02:30 and 04:00 (shared server); checked in CI and at every start
